About

Your security,

Avantis Security is a Canadian physical security firm providing uniformed guard services, access control, event and mobile patrol, executive protection and loss prevention.

Every contract is built from a site assessment, staffed with vetted and trained officers, and managed under a named supervisor for the duration of the engagement.

What we deploy

Services

Contracted capabilities, scoped per site following an initial assessment.

01

Uniformed guard patrol

Static and roving officers for lobbies, perimeters and grounds, with logged checkpoints.

02

Access control & concierge

Front-desk screening, visitor management and credentialing for buildings that need a public face.

03

Event security

Crowd management, entry screening and coordination for one-off or recurring events of any size.

04

Mobile patrol & alarm response

Marked vehicle patrols across multiple sites with dispatched response to triggered alarms.

05

Executive protection

Discreet close-protection and travel security for principals and high-visibility staff.

06

Loss prevention

Retail floor presence and covert observation to reduce shrink without disrupting customers.

Why Avantis

Structured selection and training

Officers complete a defined screening and training process, including background checks, before assignment to a contract.

Named site supervision

Each contract is assigned a supervisor as the direct point of contact for schedule or scope changes.

Site-specific post orders

Post orders are drafted per site following assessment, not issued from a standard template.

Standardized reporting

Shift logs and incident reports are issued on a consistent schedule for each contract.

Client scope
Single point of contact across multiple property types.

Clients managing a mix of commercial, residential, retail or event properties are coordinated under one contract and one supervisory contact rather than separate vendors per site.

How it starts

Engagement process

Step 01

Site assessment

A site visit is conducted to document coverage requirements and risk factors.

Step 02

Coverage plan

A written proposal is issued covering staffing levels, shift patterns and post orders.

Step 03

Deployment

Officers are scheduled and briefed on post orders prior to the first shift.

Step 04

Ongoing reporting

Shift logs are issued on a set schedule, with a direct contact for adjustments.
